propositions: The test deterministically kills xdist worker on macOS py3.13 because its unbounded cost (504.8s saturated) exceeds CI's 300s per-test timeout guard.
Single monolithic loop iterates 884 corpus units, each rendered twice (~1768 pandoc spawns), with no work distribution across xdist workers.
pytest-timeout with thread method calls os._exit(1) from timer thread, killing worker outright with no traceback rather than failing the test.
Fix chunks the equivalence test into fixed-size parametrized cases (40 units per chunk) so corpus growth adds cases but never lengthens a single case.
Coverage guard test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit ensures all chunks reassemble to complete corpus and no units are silently dropped.
Byte-identity property is preserved: all 884 units still compared with real pandoc on both _convert and oracle, _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE remains 1.
